dedupe_keys.name: genesis pick and place state and fault measurements

description: inIT publishes Genesis demonstrator measurements through Kaggle. The pneumatic pick-and-place system sorts wood and metal using storage, sensing and destination modules, with a linear drive and gripper. The first data group has two CSV files containing the same 16220 observations at 50 ms intervals, differing only in labels: PLC state-machine labels or manually annotated drive-anomaly labels. The second group contains separate normal, impaired-linear-drive and reduced-air-pressure runs for predictive maintenance and anomaly detection. Coverage is this demonstrator; calendar dates are not stated. The provider warns that the two groups are not necessarily compatible, so they remain described as components of one release without assuming aligned experiments. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms are stated; reuse charges are not stated. A limitation is that source claims about label accuracy were not independently checked. Related OPAK/IMPROVE projects establish the research context. The files provide condition monitoring inputs, not a complete executable controller. No measurements, photographs or code were retrieved.
